name: setting-row
purpose: One setting inside a flush `Card`: an `Item` whose content carries the title and description, with the control placed by what it needs. A typed or picked field sits in a right cell capped at the 3xs container so every field on the card ends at the same edge (`field`); a switch or a button sits hard right at its natural width (`compact`); a textarea, list, radio group or editor drops under the copy at the full measure (`stacked`). A child setting indents one or two levels under a rule (`level`).
useWhen: Every row of a settings card: account settings, build settings, create pages, resource settings.
A field with a validation message under it (put the `HelperText` in the default slot after the control).
avoidWhen: A stand-alone form field with a visible label above it → use `field-text` and the other `field-*` components.
A read-only list of label and value pairs → use `key-value-pairs`.
A navigable list row → use `item` directly.
related: settings-section` — the band the card of rows sits in.
item` — the row primitive it renders; place rows in an `Item.List` inside the card.
helper-text` — the required or invalid message under the control.
bestPractices: The title is the label: give the control the same text as `aria-label`.
Pick `kind` by the control: `field` for Input and Select, `compact` for Switch and Button, `stacked` for Textarea, radio groups and editors.
Show a validation message only after Save was pressed.
Use `level` only for a setting that applies when the row above it is on, and render it with `v-if` on that state.

props.name: title
props.doc: The setting name; the control takes the same text as its aria-label.

props.name: description
props.doc: One sentence under the title that says what the setting does.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Where the control sits relative to the copy.

props.name: level
props.doc: Indent depth under a rule, for a setting that only applies when its parent is on.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The control, plus the HelperText message under it when there is one.

slots.name: title
slots.notes: Rich title content (a Tag, a Hint); replaces the `title` prop.

slots.name: description
slots.notes: Rich description content (links, inline code); replaces the `description` prop.

examples.name: SettingsCard
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Card from '@aziontech/webkit/card'
  import Input from '@aziontech/webkit/input'
  import Item from '@aziontech/webkit/item'
  import SettingRow from '@aziontech/webkit/setting-row'
  import Textarea from '@aziontech/webkit/textarea'
  import { reactive } from 'vue'

  const form = reactive({ companyName: '', companyId: '', billingEmails: 'jane.doe@example.com' })
</script>

<template>
  <Card :padded="false">
    <template #content>
      <Item.List>
        <SettingRow
          title="Company Name"
          description="The legal entity that owns this account."
        >
          <Input
            v-model="form.companyName"
            size="large"
            class="w-full"
            aria-label="Company Name"
            placeholder="Company S.A."
          />
        </SettingRow>
        <SettingRow
          title="Company ID"
          description="Personal or company ID number that identifies account ownership."
        >
          <Input
            v-model="form.companyId"
            size="large"
            class="w-full"
            aria-label="Company ID"
            placeholder="00.000.000/0001-00"
          />
        </SettingRow>
        <SettingRow
          title="Billing emails"
          description="Billing is forwarded to every address listed here. Separate each one with a semicolon ( ; )."
          kind="stacked"
        >
          <Textarea
            v-model="form.billingEmails"
            class="w-full"
            :rows="3"
            aria-label="Billing emails"
          />
        </SettingRow>
      </Item.List>
    </template>
  </Card>
</template>

examples.name: CompactRows
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import Card from '@aziontech/webkit/card'
  import Item from '@aziontech/webkit/item'
  import SettingRow from '@aziontech/webkit/setting-row'
  import Switch from '@aziontech/webkit/switch'
  import { reactive } from 'vue'

  const form = reactive({ allowSocialLogin: true, enforceMfa: false })
</script>

<template>
  <Card :padded="false">
    <template #content>
      <Item.List>
        <SettingRow
          title="Allow social login"
          description="Users linked to the account can log in with their social network credentials."
          kind="compact"
        >
          <Switch
            v-model="form.allowSocialLogin"
            aria-label="Allow social login"
          />
        </SettingRow>
        <SettingRow
          title="Enforce multi-factor authentication"
          description="MFA is required on login for every user linked to this account."
          kind="compact"
        >
          <Switch
            v-model="form.enforceMfa"
            aria-label="Enforce multi-factor authentication"
          />
        </SettingRow>
        <SettingRow
          title="Authenticator devices"
          description="Manage the devices and recovery codes registered for this account."
          kind="compact"
        >
          <Button
            type="button"
            label="Manage"
            kind="outlined"
            size="medium"
          />
        </SettingRow>
      </Item.List>
    </template>
  </Card>
</template>

examples.name: WithMessage
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Card from '@aziontech/webkit/card'
  import HelperText from '@aziontech/webkit/helper-text'
  import Input from '@aziontech/webkit/input'
  import Item from '@aziontech/webkit/item'
  import SettingRow from '@aziontech/webkit/setting-row'
  import { reactive } from 'vue'

  const form = reactive({ name: '' })
</script>

<template>
  <Card :padded="false">
    <template #content>
      <Item.List>
        <SettingRow
          title="Name"
          description="Give a unique and descriptive name to identify the resource."
        >
          <Input
            v-model="form.name"
            size="large"
            class="w-full"
            aria-label="Name"
            placeholder="office-ranges"
            autocomplete="off"
            required
            aria-describedby="resource-name-message"
          />
          <HelperText
            id="resource-name-message"
            kind="required"
            label="This field is required."
          />
        </SettingRow>
      </Item.List>
    </template>
  </Card>
</template>
